title: Benchmarking Open-Ended Multi-Agent Coordination in Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.08340v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, they must coordinate with others over long horizons in open-ended interactive tasks. Yet existing evaluations rarely test these demands together, focusing instead on single-agent tasks, short interactions, or highly structured multi-agent settings. We introduce $alem$, a JAX-based benchmark for open-ended multi-agent coordination built on Craftax-like dynamics. Alem embeds procedurally generated coordination tasks, soft specialisation, communication, and controllable coordination difficulty into a long-horizon survival world with exploration, crafting, trading, and combat. We evaluate $13$ LLMs zero-shot within homogeneous teams, with trained MARL agents as reference points. Current LLM agents remain far from solving alem, averaging only ~6% normalised return, but their failures are not uniform. On the hardest coordination setting, zero-shot Gemini-3.1-Pro-High approa

translated_title: 语言智能体中开放式多智能体协作的基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着语言模型越来越多地被部署为自主智能体，它们必须在开放式交互任务中与他人进行长时程协作。然而，现有评估很少将这些需求结合在一起进行测试，而是侧重于单智能体任务、短时交互或高度结构化的多智能体设置。我们提出了 alem，一个基于 JAX 构建的开放式多智能体协作基准，其建立在类 Craftax 的动态机制之上。Alem 将程序化生成的协作任务、软专业化、通信以及可控的协作难度嵌入到一个包含探索、制作、交易和战斗的长时程生存世界中。我们在同质团队中对 13 个大语言模型进行零样本评估，并以训练好的 MARL（多智能体强化学习）智能体作为参考基准。当前的 LLM 智能体远未能解决 alem，平均归一化回报仅约 6%，但它们的失败表现并不一致。在最困难的协作设置中，零样本的 Gemini-3.1-Pro-High 接近……
tldr: 提出了基于 JAX 的开放式多智能体协作基准 Alem，将程序化协作任务、软专业化和通信嵌入长时程生存世界中，评估显示当前 LLM 智能体平均归一化回报仅约 6%，远未解决该基准。
en_tdlr: Introduces Alem, a JAX-based benchmark for open-ended multi-agent coordination that embeds procedurally generated coordination tasks, soft specialisation, and communication in a long-horizon survival world, showing that current LLM agents average only ~6% normalised return and remain far from solving it.
